title: Transfer - Silicone Pour Plan
goal: Process an ASCII STL of a scanned mold insert with stray fragments, isolate the largest watertight component, and compute the silicone pour volume and reserve amount required from a supplied process sheet.
skillBenefitRationale: `mesh-analysis` is the unique shipped skill that matters here because the task hinges on STL parsing plus debris filtering to recover an accurate cavity volume from the main mesh.
